case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guest feedback praised the hotel's location, ocean views, comfortable clean rooms, tasty breakfast and kind staff, and noted convenient parking and good value. Reported negatives included repeated mentions of closed or nonworking wellness/jacuzzi facilities and top-floor amenities, limited toiletries and a cleanliness complaint, an instance of unhelpful reception/delayed check-in, and a late-night lack of food; one guest also cited poor weather.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Run immediate refresher training, implement delayed-room SOP with notification/apology/compensation, and post-check-in survey with weekly coaching.
Immediately inspect wellness/top-floor; if unrepaired, close, update bookings, compensate guests, review maintenance, consider capital assessment.
Audit recently-departed rooms/areas, retrain housekeeping, introduce signed per-room-checklist, temporarily increase supervisor-inspections, publicly explain corrective actions.
Inspect jacuzzi, equipment, review hours/staffing, communicate availability, commission technical assessment before capital works if issues.
